description:
Palace On Wheels: Shahi Train Ka Safar! 👑

🚂 India's pioneer royal luxury tourist train

Palace on Wheels, launched in 1982 by RTDC and Indian Railways, offers 7-night heritage tours across Rajasthan; fares typically range between $4,000 to $10,000+ per passenger (₹3.5 to ₹8+ Lakh) depending on suite class.

👉 Agar ek luxury train tour chunna ho, toh kiske saath jaana chahenge?
